tasks.title: Voltage drop across the connector
tasks.solution: R of the circuit = 2·R contact; U = I·R. Example: 10 A and 20 mΩ → 10 × 0.040 = 0.40 V. The power in the connector is P = I²·R — 4 W with the same numbers.

tasks.title: 1S sag under load
tasks.solution: U = E − I·(R cell + R wire and connector). Example: 3.90 V, 60 mΩ, 44 mΩ, 10 A → 3.90 − 10 × 0.104 = 2.86 V — below the 3.30 V critical threshold with a half-full cell.
